claim: Enclosed service nodes only close macro-stage dependencies; they do not demonstrate that every original manual operation in that stage has been reproduced. Authored detailed operations are also not transcriptions of the original authors' actions.

stages.stage: Native-oxide treatment of the original rod
stages.expanded: Load the original rod together with its cassette, close the door, establish work-order identity, obtain safe release, and retrieve it
stages.not_expanded: Real chemical treatment and manual micro-operations involving vessels/tools, transfers, residue checks, rinsing, and drying
stages.source_support: f.materials is used only for macro stages; the specific robotic handoffs are authored

stages.expanded: Separate trays, load the drawer, mate the PC plates, hand off, and retrieve
stages.not_expanded: Real vacuum/thermal cycles, sealing, temperature calibration, and internal heat-treatment operations

stages.expanded: Pick and place tubes/rods, insert the rod coaxially, fit five layers of tubing, and sort by dimensions
stages.not_expanded: Internal manual operations during diameter-reduction drawing, the original authors' tools, and action trajectories/tolerances
stages.source_support: Rod insertion and the jacket macrostructure are source-supported; the V-groove, push rod, and assembly order are authored

stages.expanded: Select cladding, place or omit the core, and use separate condition carriers
stages.not_expanded: Complete preparation steps and exact sealing processes for Ge/silica and Ge/BSG
stages.source_support: f.ed1/f.ed4; reuse of the sealing-service interface is authored and does not establish that the source controls used the same sealing method

stages.expanded: Load and unload the assembly together with its carrier
stages.not_expanded: Real internal micro-operations for flame alignment/rotation, vacuum-line connection, heat sealing, and leak testing

stages.expanded: Cold-state preform feed seat, reel installation, external leader routing, door/panel operation, and reel unloading
stages.not_expanded: Real fibre initiation, hot-neck manipulation, and methods of controlling/adjusting in-furnace temperature, tension, and crystallization
stages.source_support: f.materials/f.main; external leader routing is not footage of the authors initiating the fibre

stages.expanded: Deploy supports, clamp both ends, close the cover, trigger cutting, and compartmentalize segments and remainder
stages.not_expanded: The authors' cutting tools, blade contact trajectories, and wear
stages.source_support: The source explicitly states only that 80cm segments are cut; the proxy cutter is not the original tool

stages.expanded: Load the entire long trough, retrieve it safely, and retain fragments in their cassette
stages.not_expanded: Real chemical de-cladding, vessels/tools, rinsing, drying, and liquid-waste handling

stages.expanded: Hand off control preforms, retrieve retained specimens, and use profile carriers
stages.not_expanded: Real withdrawal from the furnace zone, quenching actions, and quenching media

stages.expanded: Seat transversely/longitudinally, hand off embedding cassettes, retrieve lamella carriers, and preserve child lineage
stages.not_expanded: Real resin mixing/curing, successive grinding/polishing tools and techniques, and FIB milling trajectories

stages.expanded: Place two plates in the locating seat, secure their outer edges, issue the work order, retrieve, and inspect
stages.not_expanded: Real milling-cutter motion/feed, chip removal, and the original authors' fixturing

stages.expanded: Remove two inserts from the small box, seat them between the slots, position them with a soft pressure tab, and mate the upper plate
stages.not_expanded: The original manufacturing relationship between film and inserts, the authors' tools/contact forces, and exact actions
stages.source_support: The source supports the inserts and consolidation; the soft pressure tab and keyed slots are authored

stages.expanded: Install the preform/core carrier/wire reels; feed metal from both sides and single/dual cores centrally; wind and unload the reel
stages.not_expanded: Real fine-core threading, tensioning, core-feed continuation, hot-neck regulation, and self-alignment/contact micro-actions
stages.source_support: f.materials/f.main; the task end clamps/feed guides are authored

stages.expanded: Clamp the end, perform proxy stripping, collect fragments, attach both terminal tabs, and check the connections
stages.not_expanded: The original authors' fibre-stripper model/stroke, wiring connectors, and contact-resistance calibration
stages.source_support: The source reports a fibre stripper and metal-electrode connections

stages.expanded: Sample carriers, orientation, lens assemblies/wiring, doors, condition switching, and safe sample unloading
stages.not_expanded: Real microscope focusing/scanning, electron-beam/radiation operations, precise optical alignment, probe calibration, and internal instrument techniques
stages.source_support: f.materials/f.measure; all specific robotic interfaces are authored

stages.expanded: Fixturing/radius fixtures/load attachment/winding/laundry loading/same-object recovery storage/sample unloading
stages.not_expanded: Complete CAD of the original fixtures, real clamping forces/tensions, pendulum/torsion details, and control micro-actions
stages.source_support: The macro test types are source-supported; the fixtures/buttons and operation paths are authored

stages.expanded: Thread the task channels, connect numbered boards, fit a cap to the mannequin, use a garment stand/phantom, assemble the eight-angle shell and board box, and place in/retrieve from the tank
stages.not_expanded: The original authors' knitting methods/adhesive bonding/board soldering, real public-space/human trials, and underwater navigation control
stages.source_support: The application structures are source-supported; task channels/inert boards/phantoms/reversible tabs are explicit substitutes

stages.expanded: Carriers, grasping, movement, source shutdown, cable disconnection, compartmentalization, return of remainder/tools, and enclosed waste handoff
stages.not_expanded: The authors' actual transport routes/storage/cleanup SOPs are not reported
stages.source_support: Designed to close the experimental workflow; not attributed to the authors' historical actions
